STA printed '01:55/23:55Z+1'. Resolved the +1 as belonging to the ARN local reading only: STD 21:30Z plus the printed Block 2h25 gives 23:55Z on 09-03, and to_utc confirms ARN 2026-09-04T01:55 local = 2026-09-03T23:55Z.

Off Duty printed '00:50/23:50Z+1'. Resolved to 2026-09-04T23:50Z (LHR local 00:50 on 09-05 confirmed by to_utc as 23:20Z-class same-day rollover); report 18:10Z to 23:50Z equals the printed Duty 5h40, which the next-day reading would not.
STD printed '01:21/23:21Z+1'. to_utc gives BCN 2026-09-09T01:21 local = 2026-09-08T23:21Z, so the departure is still on 09-08 while its arrival 01:26Z falls on 09-09.

Second duty of the day; Off Duty printed '11:39/10:39Z+1' on page 2. The +1 here does move the UTC into 09-13 (10:39Z), verified because report 21:35Z on 09-12 to 10:39Z on 09-13 equals the printed Duty 13h04.
